stories.headline: 1 Big Winner and 1 Loser From the Upcoming Anthropic IPO
stories.body: Key PointsBroadcom has a multi-year agreement with Anthropic that’s worth tens of billions of dollars.

stories.headline: Survey: Firms commit to marketing but aren't tracking the results
stories.body: In two reports, the PR firm Gregory finds prominent wealth managers sometimes never show up in AI search results and that few firms are doing enough to track whether all the money they spend on marketing is having the desired effect.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley are dominating the AI stock boom. Here's their edge
stories.body: Wall Street’s Big Three have generated $52 billion in equity trading revenue this year, capturing about 80% of the market on rising margin lending to hedge funds.
